info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Education Enrollments Payments-v4-spec
info.description: The Education Enrollment Payment Listing API provides access to detailed information regarding payments associated with education enrollments. This endpoint allows users to retrieve a comprehensive list of payment records, facilitating the management and oversight of financial transactions. Typically used by education administrators and financial departments, this API is essential for reporting, analysis, and ensuring reconciliation of enrollment-related payments. By leveraging this API, organizations can streamline their financial operations and enhance transparency in educational enrollments.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the payment information related to enrollments. You can use this to get insights into payment statuses, amounts, and related details for enrolled items.

requestBody.description: Request payload for initiating a payment enrollment. This should contain the necessary details required for processing the payment.

ListEducationEnrollmentsPaymentsRequest.description: A JSON string representation of the request body for the GET operation on payment enrollments.

status.description: Indicates whether the payment operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The unique reference number associated with this payment operation.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the payment processing.

state.description: The current state of the payment operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the payment, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional details about the payment operation.

audit.description: Information about the audit of the payment operation.

ListEducationEnrollmentsPaymentsResponse.description: Response schema for the payment operation GET request.

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the payment record.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the payment record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the payment processing was automated.

Audit.description: Audit information associated with the payment operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. This can be useful for performance monitoring and debugging.
